chunks.subject: AP Microeconomics
chunks.title: Q1 Long FRQ (10 points) — Set 2: perfect competition (Deskward, wooden desks)
chunks.content: AP Microeconomics FRQ 1 (Long), 10 points, one per element. Set 2 (market for wooden desks and the firm Deskward, a perfectly competitive firm): draw a correctly labeled side-by-side market graph (downward-sloping demand, upward supply) and firm graph (horizontal demand = MR = price at the market price); state that Deskward's profit-maximizing quantity will not change in the short run under a given scenario and explain; plus related state/explain elements on profit/loss areas and long-run adjustment. Common failure: firm's demand not horizontal at the market price; profit-max where MR≠MC; stating short-run/long-run outcomes without the perfect-competition reasoning.

chunks.content: Q1 (Set 2) scored 10/10 — correctly labeled market and firm graphs (horizontal firm demand at the market price), the correct short-run quantity statement with explanation, and all remaining elements. Full-credit model.

chunks.title: Q1 Set 2 exemplar — Sample 1B, 6/10
chunks.content: Q1 (Set 2) scored 6/10 — earned the graph-labeling and simpler state points but lost several explain-dependent points (short-run/long-run reasoning). Illustrates graph/state points earned, explain points missed.

chunks.subject: AP Microeconomics
chunks.title: Q1 Set 2 exemplar — Sample 1C, 3/10
chunks.content: Q1 (Set 2) scored 3/10 — earned about three elements (a labeled graph and one or two simple state answers), losing the firm-demand positioning and the state-and-explain reasoning. Illustrates a low response with fragments of the graphs but no multi-step perfect-competition reasoning.
